arxiv-1710-06721.title: Radioactive heat production of six geologically important nuclides
arxiv-1710-06721.creator: Thomas Ruedas
arxiv-1710-06721.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Thomas Ruedas. Heat production rates for the geologically important nuclides 26 Al, 40 K, 60 Fe, 232 Th, 235 U, and 238 U are calculated on the basis of recent data on atomic and nuclear properties.

arxiv-2109-03194.title: On the Convergence of Decentralized Adaptive Gradient Methods
arxiv-2109-03194.creator: Xiangyi Chen, Belhal Karimi, Weijie Zhao, Ping Li
arxiv-2109-03194.description: Abstract 1 1 1 The work of Xiangyi Chen was conducted while he was an intern at Baidu Research – Bellevue in Summer 2019. Adaptive gradient methods including Adam, AdaGrad, and their variants have been very successful for training deep learning models, such as neural networks.

arxiv-2309-12082.title: Estimating Stable Fixed Points and Langevin Potentials for Financial Dynamics
arxiv-2309-12082.creator: Tobias Wand, Timo Wiedemann, Jan Harren, Oliver Kamps
arxiv-2309-12082.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tobias Wand, Timo Wiedemann, Jan Harren, Oliver Kamps. The Geometric Brownian Motion (GBM) is a standard model in quantitative finance, but the potential function of its stochastic differential equation (SDE) cannot include stable nonzero prices. This article generalises the GBM to an SDE with polynomial drift of order q q and shows via model selection that q = 2 q=2 is most frequently the optimal model to describe the data.

arxiv-2311-04284.title: CRAB: Assessing the Strength of Causal Relationships Between Real-World Events
arxiv-2311-04284.creator: Angelika Romanou, Syrielle Montariol, Debjit Paul, Léo Laugier, Karl Aberer, Antoine Bosselut EPFL {firstname.lastname}@epfl.ch
arxiv-2311-04284.description: Abstract Understanding narratives requires reasoning about the cause-and-effect relationships between events mentioned in the text. While existing foundation models yield impressive results in many NLP tasks requiring reasoning, it is unclear whether they understand the complexity of the underlying network of causal relationships of events in narratives.

arxiv-2403-06125.title: Transverse-momentum-dependent gluon distributions of proton within basis light-front quantization
arxiv-2403-06125.creator: Hongyao Yu, Zhi Hu, Siqi Xu, Chandan Mondal, Xingbo Zhao, James P. Vary, (BLFQ Collaboration)
arxiv-2403-06125.description: Abstract Gluon transverse-momentum dependent distributions (TMDs) are very important for revealing the internal structure of the proton. They correspond to a variety of experiments and are among the major tasks of the future electron-ion colliders. In this paper, we calculate the T-even gluon TMDs at the leading twist within the Basis Light-front Quantization framework.

arxiv-2503-10530.title: Lightweight Models for Emotional Analysis in Video
arxiv-2503-10530.creator: Quoc-Tien Nguyen, Hong-Hai Nguyen, Van-Thong Huynh
arxiv-2503-10530.description: Abstract In this study, we present an approach for efficient spatiotemporal feature extraction using MobileNetV4 and a multi-scale 3D MLP-Mixer-based temporal aggregation module. MobileNetV4, with its Universal Inverted Bottleneck (UIB) blocks, serves as the backbone for extracting hierarchical feature representations from input image sequences, ensuring both computational efficiency and rich semantic encoding.

pmc-10880836.title: Does Burnout Lead to Poor Organizational Commitment among Prison Officers in Sri Lanka?: Findings from a Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-10880836.creator: Nimali F. Wijegoonewardene, Janaki P. Vidanapathirana
pmc-10880836.description: Burnout is a recognized risk factor for poor organizational commitment across occupational groups. This has not been explored among Sri Lankan prison officers previously. The aim of this article is to identify whether burnout was an associated risk factor for poor organizational commitment in this occupational group.

pmc-11836649.description: IntroductionThis study was conducted to determine the specific features of the mutual influence of the immune and haemostatic systems in immunohaemostasis, the role of immune reactions in the regulation of blood coagulation, and the efficacy of modern methods of treating thrombosis and bleeding.

pmc-12613029.creator: Karma Nanglu, Madeleine E. Waskom, Sarah R. Losso, Javier Ortega-Hernández
pmc-12613029.description: SummaryThe Paleozoic fossil record provides unique insights into the evolution of life history traits through the direct preservation of interspecific interactions in deep time. pmc-13487474.creator: Yifan Zhang, Xiaoning Wang
pmc-13487474.description: . The patient developed progressive enlargement of cervical and axillary lymph nodes. Histopathological and immunohistochemical findings are consistent with posttransplant lymphoproliferative disorder (PTLD). Following treatment with rituximab (600 mg per dose, 2 doses), the lymphadenopathy completely resolved. The patient presented with a shadow and vision loss in the right eye 7 months after transplantation.

pmc-13559188.title: Despair is Not Hopelessness: Autonomy and Behavioral Interventions for Deaths of Despair
pmc-13559188.creator: Alejandro Hortal, Jack M C Kwong
pmc-13559188.description: The term ‘deaths of despair’ refers to suicide, drug overdoses, and alcohol-related mortality in the context of concern about rising mortality rates. This paper employs a philosophical distinction between despair and hopelessness, and their positive counterparts, hope and hopefulness, to examine how behavioral public policy can offer tools to reduce these deaths and what role autonomy plays in such contexts.
